items.name: Oxlo.ai
items.tagline: Scale across AI models without scaling your bill
items.description: Most AI teams pick a model first and discover the bill later. We built Oxlo.ai to change that. Access 35+ frontier AI models including DeepSeek V4 Pro, Kimi K2.6, GLM 5, Qwen, Llama, and Mistral through a single API. Compare models, calibrate responses, and choose the right model for each use case. Scale across AI models with predictable monthly subscriptions, benchmark-grade performance, generous usage limits, and we never train on your data.

items.name: BrowserAct
items.tagline: Web browser automation for AI agents
items.description: BrowserAct is built for agents using the web. It gives agents a browser layer for real websites, so they can pass blocked pages, adapt to real scenarios, run multiple tasks safely, and return clean web data for reasoning. Use BrowserAct when an agent needs to browse, click, extract, fill forms, upload files, work inside logged-in sites, handle verification, or run repeatable browser workflows.

items.name: Zaro
items.tagline: Build agents & apps on top of your context with one prompt.
items.description: Zaro is where you can build working software from your scattered work. Everything you know is spread across Gmail, Slack, notes, and tabs that don't talk - Zaro pulls it into one place and lets you build apps from it in minutes: your research, your side projects, your plans, your decisions. Then they keep themselves updated, checking your connections every day so you don't have to. No code. No maintenance. No graveyard of prototypes you started and never finished.

items.name: Figma Motion
items.tagline: Your Figma canvas now has a timeline
items.description: Motion now lives on the canvas—in the same file as your components, your variables, and your team—so your designs can come to life from day one.

items.name: Brain² by ClickUp
items.tagline: One AI that knows your entire company and acts on it
items.description: Brain² knows every task, Doc, chat, and decision, and how they all connect. No re-explaining required. Pick any AI model, connect all your apps, and let AI work with full context of your company. Memory, agents, and MCP integrations built in.

items.name: Samepage Signals
items.tagline: Your second brain for product management
items.description: Built specifically for the best product leaders, Samepage Signals automatically surfaces the information and insights that are most important to you across all of your tools and web, in one place.

items.name: Tough Tongue AI for Sales
items.tagline: Live AI teammate for every tough sales conversation
items.description: Create *Live* AI teammates for every tough sales conversation. Each teammate shows up with human-like voice, avatar, and tools in minutes, can be deployed to phone, Google Meet, Zoom, or your application, and self-improves with every conversation. Use them to qualify leads, run autonomous product demos, coach new sales reps, and support your team live when the deal is on the line.

items.name: Polygraph
items.tagline: Let AI agents see cross repo and maintain session memory.
items.description: AI coding agents are limited to how autonomously they can work because they have no model of the codebase as a whole. Polygraph is a meta-harness that gives agents what they're missing: Visibility across every repo boundary and memory that survives the session. Connect all your repos, private and public, into a unified dependency graph without moving any code. Resume, reference or build on any session created by any developer, on another machine, even on different agents.

items.name: Genspark Design
items.tagline: Generate UI prototypes, videos, and posters with AI
items.description: Genspark Design generates UI prototypes, HTML animations, videos, and posters from a prompt. Upload Figma files to maintain brand consistency across outputs. For non-designers who need production-ready creative assets.

items.name: Papermark Agents
items.tagline: Let AI agents run your next deal, fundraise or data room
items.description: Papermark for Agents lets AI run your secure data rooms for you. Just ask: build a data room, upload and organize files, create watermarked links, or see which investors actually read your deck. 40+ MCP tools, plus a REST API and CLI. Open source, secure by default, and built for Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, and your own code.

items.name: MeetPoint
items.tagline: Find the city where everyone's flights are cheapest
items.description: Enter everyone's city, pick travel dates, and MeetPoint finds the best place to meet — with live flight prices from every origin.

items.name: Postproxy - Engagement API
items.tagline: Publish, reply, and analyze social media via API
items.description: Postproxy is a social media API for products that need more than publishing. Publish posts, manage comments, DMs and reviews, track post and profile analytics, and receive webhooks across major platforms. Built for SaaS products, automation workflows, and agents that need reliable social media infrastructure without maintaining every platform API themselves.

items.name: Grass 2.0
items.tagline: The always-on computer for your coding agents
items.description: Grass gives your coding agents their own always-on cloud computer. Run Claude Code, Codex, or OpenCode on Grass, then monitor progress, approve decisions, and push changes from your iPhone. Version 2 is faster, redesigned, and now live on the App Store.

items.name: Milestones
items.tagline: Native project planning app, now on Mac & with an MCP server
items.description: After a long time with lots of iterations, Milestones is finally available on macOS and even comes with an MCP! Milestones lets you plan projects, break them up into manageable milestones, and track the progress so you never lose focus. Privacy-focused, with sync directly to your iCloud account.

items.name: Nashra
items.tagline: Turn followers into clients.
items.description: Your followers live on platforms you don't own. Nashra gives experts one home for everything: newsletter, blog, bio Hub, and landing pages, all on a single subscriber spine. Post on social, build here. Leave whenever, take everything. What's new in 2.0: AI landing page builder, an AI Strategist that lifts your open rates, full RTL (write in Arabic, Farsi, and more), SEO-optimized blogging, and white-glove migration. Free up to 500 subscribers.

items.name: Dub Ninja
items.tagline: Live autonomous AI DJ that digs, mixes & explains 24/7
items.description: An autonomous AI DJ. No schedule, no playlists — just the next correct record, chosen live and explained in real time. Underground electronic, always on.

items.name: SendTidings
items.tagline: Turn your analytics into beautiful monthly email reports
items.description: SendTidings connects to Plausible, Matomo, GA4, Search Console and other data sources, then sends clean, scheduled email reports straight to your clients' inboxes. No logins, no dashboards they'll never open. Set it up once, look organised forever.

items.name: Heron
items.tagline: Wireshark for AI Agents: passive eBPF observability
items.description: Heron is a passive network analyzer that reconstructs what your AI agents are actually doing. Zero SDKs. Zero proxy. Hook eBPF to see TLS-encrypted LLM calls and identify which agent process made them.

items.name: SayCraft
items.tagline: Build a web app by talking through a meeting
items.description: SayCraft turns a real-time team meeting into a working web app. You talk — alone or with your team — the AI builds live, and a shareable preview URL updates as you speak. Walk away with a working product, the source code, and one-click deploy. No prompts.

items.name: VTT for Mac
items.tagline: Voice-to-text for macOS with a fully on-device option
items.description: Dictate in the language you're already typing in — VTT detects your keyboard layout and routes to the right engine across 26 languages. Speak; text appears at your cursor in any Mac app. On-device or cloud engines, your call. No account.
